cohort: The study included 296 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes from an Obstetrics and Gynaecology department at a tertiary care center in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh.
finding: The study found an increased prevalence of maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality in women with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were common, occurring in 58.8% (174 cases) of women with gestational diabetes.
